source_instruction: i am looking for a multi-colored blackout window film for my living room.
query:
Hey, I just got back from walking my rescue pit bull Mabel at the community trail half a block from my apartment, and oh my gosh, the silliest thing happened when we passed the little community garden plot I’ve been tending all spring. A plump, fluffy baby rabbit hopped right out from under my raised bed of cherry tomatoes, sat up on its hind legs, and stared Mabel down for a full 30 seconds like it was daring her to come closer, even though Mabel was so focused on sniffing a dandelion patch she didn’t even notice the little guy was there. I had to stop and snap a blurry photo of it before it bounded off into the blackberry brambles, and I swear I’m gonna tape it to my fridge later because it was such a perfect, tiny unexpected moment that made my whole morning feel brighter. I even stopped at the corner food cart on the walk back and grabbed a cold lemon poppyseed muffin to eat when I get home, still warm from the oven, and it’s got that perfect crumbly sugar top I’ve been craving for weeks now.
Hey, I’m browsing the window coverings section right now and need something for my home gym first off. I want to go with that one option I always pick for these, you know the one I mean? I don’t want to spend too much, so just keep it under a reasonable amount that won’t break my casual budget right now. Can you pull up matching options for me when you get a sec?
